visualCharacteristics.purpose: Look-only AI-powered search: input, AI summary toggle, summary with disclaimer, static results, Try again / Load more buttons

contentPattern.structure: key | value rows: Placeholder, Toggle, Summary, Disclaimer, Result (repeat per result), Try Again, Load More, Page Size; unknown or single-cell rows are results

reuseGuidance: Static demo only: no search or AI service is called. Search filters the authored results client-side, the toggle shows/hides the summary, Load more reveals the next page, Try again replays a loading state.
